sentences.text: % 09.09.2024 CRL.M.A. 27118/2024 (Exemption) Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

The Petitioners have approached this Court for quashing FIR No.776/2021, registered at Police Station Jahangirpuri for offences punishable under Sections 498A/509/354C/323/377/406/34 IPC on the ground that the parties have entered into a settlement.
2. It is stated that the Respondent No.2 is not available today.

3. List on 23.09.2024 in the supplementary list.
SUBRAMONIUM PRASAD, J SEPTEMBER 9, 2024 S. Zakir
